newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican train derails, killing 14 - Red Cross.
newsitem.headline: Mexican train derails, killing 14 - Red Cross.

text.p: A passenger train derailed just outside Mexico City on Wednesday, killing 14 people, injuring eight and leaving three people trapped, the Mexican Red Cross said.
"The train derailed," Red Cross radio operator Gonzalo Luna told Reuters. "We don't have all the exact details yet."
The accident occurred about 12 miles (20 km) south of Mexico City as the train was en route to the city of Cuernavaca, Luna said.
He said three passengers were trapped for some time following the accident, but were later freed.
All of the dead were passengers, Luna said, adding that the two engineers escaped unhurt.
